findings.label: lucide iconLibrary without lucide-react
findings.detail: components.json declares iconLibrary "lucide" but lucide-react is not installed (icons are inlined). A future `shadcn add <component>` will generate unresolvable lucide-react imports. Note it in a comment or add lucide-react when the next shadcn component lands.

findings.label: Test file not type-checked
findings.detail: The test lives outside tsc's include and bun does not type-check, so type drift only surfaces at runtime. Optionally add a tests tsconfig with bun-types.

findings.label: Branch behind main
findings.detail: main gained PR #13 (server upload MIME fix) after branching; a two-dot diff shows server files reverted. Rebase/merge main before opening the PR (no overlapping files; the branch itself has no server/ changes).
